# How It Works - Step Images Guide

Save your downloaded images in this folder with the following exact names:

## Required Images:

### Step 01 - Install IoT Sensors
**Filename:** `step-01.jpg`

**Google Search Terms:**
- "IoT sensor installation agriculture" OR "wireless sensors grain storage"
- "technician installing sensors warehouse" OR "IoT device installation silo"
- "temperature sensor mounting grain bin" OR "agricultural sensor installation"

**What to Look For:**
- Professional looking image of sensors being installed
- Technician working with small electronic devices
- Wireless sensors mounted on walls or equipment
- Agricultural/warehouse setting preferred
- Clean, modern IoT sensors
- Installation or setup scene

**Image Style:** Professional, clean, showing actual installation process or mounted sensors

---

### Step 02 - Connect to Platform
**Filename:** `step-02.jpg`

**Google Search Terms:**
- "cloud computing dashboard" OR "IoT cloud platform interface"
- "wireless connectivity network" OR "data syncing cloud"
- "smartphone tablet monitoring app" OR "mobile dashboard agriculture"
- "real-time data dashboard" OR "cloud data synchronization"

**What to Look For:**
- Dashboard/interface on screen (laptop, tablet, or phone)
- Cloud connectivity visualization
- Wireless signal or sync indicators
- Modern UI with graphs/charts
- Data flowing to cloud concept
- Multi-device connectivity (phone + laptop)

**Image Style:** Modern, tech-focused, showing connectivity and cloud integration

---

### Step 03 - Monitor & Optimize
**Filename:** `step-03.jpg`

**Google Search Terms:**
- "data analytics dashboard" OR "AI analytics interface"
- "real-time monitoring graphs" OR "predictive analytics charts"
- "business intelligence dashboard" OR "data visualization monitoring"
- "alert notification system" OR "automated monitoring dashboard"

**What to Look For:**
- Analytics dashboard with multiple charts/graphs
- Line charts, bar charts, data visualizations
- Alert or notification indicators
- AI or predictive elements visible
- Professional monitoring interface
- Real-time data displays
- Trend analysis visuals

**Image Style:** Professional analytics, modern dashboard, data-rich visualization

---

## Image Specifications:
- **Format:** JPG (rename to .jpg if needed)
- **Size:** Minimum 600x600px (square), higher resolution preferred (800x800px ideal)
- **Aspect Ratio:** 1:1 (square) - will be displayed in square containers
- **Quality:** High resolution, professional looking
- **Style:** Clean, modern, business-appropriate
- **Orientation:** Square or can be cropped to square

## Recommended Image Sources:
- **Unsplash.com** (free, high quality, search: "IoT sensors", "dashboard analytics", "cloud computing")
- **Pexels.com** (free stock photos)
- **Pixabay.com** (free images)
- **Freepik.com** (free with attribution)

## Color Preference:
Images that have green, white, or neutral tones work best with the GrainHero color scheme (#2FAC0C green and #252d26 dark).

## Important Notes:
1. Make sure images are horizontally oriented or square
2. Avoid images with too much text overlay
3. Choose images that clearly represent the action/concept
4. Professional photography preferred over illustrations
5. Ensure good lighting and clarity

## After Adding Images:
The images will automatically display in the "How It Works" section on your landing page with a border and shadow effect.
